comparison.objective: Move eleven nuts to a tray while registering each one on a reset tally counter.
comparison.physical_skill: Reset and actuate a mechanical counter once per transferred part while maintaining count correspondence.
comparison.success_condition: Eleven nuts transferred and counter correctly zeroed then advanced once per nut; detailed scoring tiers are unavailable.
comparison.reason: Repeated part transfer and discrete counting do not test coaxial impact tooling or physical fracture and recovery of fragments.
